title: midweek-ceo-dropin-briefing-scratch-lucas
content:
Purpose:
- 15 minute drop-in on Weds (11:30 PT) — informal check-in, quick data, one ask.
- Keep it light; primary goal: reassure + surface 2 asks for eng and GTM.

Top-line (30s):
- Quick hello: appreciate sprint energy, shoutouts to SRE on median p95 latency work.
- State: usage up ~12% week-over-week; a few customers on Dedicated pilot; Private pipeline progressing.

Talking points (short bullets, read or paraphrase):
1) What we're seeing now
  - Traffic: API tokens up ~12% week-over-week, peak QPS still within Dedicated capacity for pilot customers.
  - Latency: median generation latency 320ms across hosted region-us-west; p95 1.8s (down from 2.4s last week).
  - Cost: average per-k token cost trending down due to batching & cache tweaks — rough estimate -8% MoM.

2) Why this matters / why I'm optimistic (20s)
  - We're hitting predictable improvements from runtime work and early customer patterns. That lets us be more aggressive on pricing and capacity guarantees for Dedicated.

3) Two asks (callouts for teams)
  - SRE/Serving-runtime: freeze on any infra-wide config changes Thurs-Fri (we're in a small rollout window). Tell: Marcus + ops to confirm gating list.
  - Product/GTM: prepare a 1-pager for pilot customers summarizing expected SLOs + fallback behavior (canary -> fallback model) by EOD Friday. Owner: Aisha.

4) On hiring / org rumors (anticipated Q)
  - Short, direct script: no company-wide hiring freeze. We're optimizing plans in specific areas to match runway and cadence. Any changes will be communicated transparently.
  - If asked about layoffs: "No, nothing to share on layoffs. We're being careful with hiring and discretionary spend."

5) Private deployments / compliance question (anticipated)
  - Status: early installs progressing; two pilots in security review. Timeline: limited GA signals in Q2; scaling conversations ongoing.
  - Ask to legal/security: have a short FAQ ready about data residency and KMS integration (link to internal brief).

6) Bad news / failures script (if someone brings up incidents)
  - Acknowledge quickly, show data: what happened, scope, timeline. Then say what we fixed and next steps. Always own it.

Open mic / Q+A (prep answers)
- Q: "When will Dedicated have price/product parity with major clouds?"
  A: "We won't match 1:1; parity on throughput + SLA is our first milestone, pricing will be competitive after scale and quantization savings."
- Q: "Are we shipping any new model families soon?"
  A: "Roadmap: focus on adapter support and a small family of tuned variants for LLM_3x in April; no sweeping catalog change this month."
- Q: "How to escalate when you see latency regressions?"
  A: "Slack #sre-ops + tag SRE pager; add regression note in ops-runbook placeholder."

Notes-to-self / things to check before drop-in:
- Confirm numbers: MAU, token volume, median/p95 latency with Marcus (live query from datadog).
- Make sure the pilot customer list for Dedicated is up-to-date (Aisha).
- Post-dropin: quick follow-up email to company with 3 bullets + links.

Script snippets (one-liners if I'm talking fast):
- "Thanks all — quick check-in: things are trending in the right direction, but there are a couple of asks we need your help on."
- "Shoutout to SRE and Serving team for the p95 improvements — keep it coming."
- "If you see anything strange with latency or quota, escalate immediately — don't assume someone else saw it."

Lines to avoid:
- "Everything is fine" (vague)
- Overpromising dates for Private GA or big pricing moves

Follow-ups after the drop-in (TODOs):
- Send 3-bullet email + links to ops metrics, pilot list, FAQ stub (Lucas).
- Aisha: 1-pager for pilots on SLOs / fallbacks.
- Marcus: confirm freeze list + publish maintenance window.

Unresolved questions (for meeting prep):
- Exact percent of traffic coming from top 5 customers (ask sales ops).
- Any outstanding legal red flags on the two Private pilots? (legal team)

Rough timing (15 min):
- 0:00–0:30 intro, 0:30–2:00 top-line metrics, 2:00–4:00 two asks, 4:00–12:00 open mic Qs, 12:00–15:00 close + next steps.

Casual signoff idea: "That's my 15 — open to quick follow-ups in #exec-dropin or ping me directly."

Scratch brainstorm (if we have time / improv):
- Consider a small internal banner for engineers showing current legacy model % of traffic vs optimized paths (quick visibility).
- Quick triage playbook card in Console for any user-facing regressions that SRE can adopt.

End.
